topic: Boruto Two Blue Vortex 37: Sarada's kidnapping was Boruto's plan, and she adapts it when it breaks
title: Sarada Planned Her Own Kidnapping (Boruto 37)
description: In Boruto: Two Blue Vortex chapter 37, Sarada walks into Code's hands on purpose. Here's what the flashback shows, how the plan breaks, and why Koji's warning matters. Was Boruto right to trust her?
comment: Koji's warning: is saving Sarada worth risking Momoshiki's return, or should Boruto let her fend for herself?

lines.text: Sarada planned her own kidnapping in Boruto chapter 37.

shot.fallback: girl with glasses and dark hair, determined

lines.text: Not a rescue gone wrong. A trap she walked into on purpose.

shot.fallback: teen ninja girl in a dark hideout, tense, anime style

lines.text: Here's what the flashback in chapter 37 shows.

shot.fallback: teen ninja girl in a dark hideout, tense, anime style

lines.text: Boruto has two ways into the shinju hideout: Code's claw marks, or his Flying Raijin.

shot.fallback: blond teen ninja teleporting in lightning

lines.text: But Flying Raijin needs symbols planted inside, and Boruto can't plant them himself.

shot.fallback: teen ninja girl in a dark hideout, tense, anime style

lines.text: So he trusts Sarada to get taken, and to mark the place for him.

shot.fallback: teen ninja girl and boy facing each other

lines.text: Then the plan breaks. Code removes the markers, and Hidari turns on her.

shot.fallback: pale hooded villain and a masked fighter in a hideout

lines.text: Sarada doesn't panic. She works out how Flying Raijin finds her, and builds a new way.
People say this chapter was just talking panels. I'd say it's her proving Boruto's trust right.

shot.fallback: teen ninja girl in a dark hideout, tense, anime style

lines.text: And Koji warns that saving her could lead to a future where Momoshiki takes over.

shot.fallback: old scientist warning, dark celestial being behind him

lines.text: So here's my read. The rescue itself might be the real trap.

shot.fallback: teen ninja girl in a dark hideout, tense, anime style

lines.text: Because Sarada planned her own kidnapping...
